detail.longDescription: I am trying to free up some disk space on a VPS (on DigitalOcean) running several Dockerfile containers. Trying to hunt down the files / directories eating up disk space, I stumbled across the directory /var/lib/docker.backup . It's located just next to the /var/lib/docker directory and uses 14G of disk space. It seems to be there for the purpose of backing up Docker (maybe images or volumes), but I could not find any information about this directory in the Dockerfile docs or online search. Do you know what use this directory has? And can I delete it without harming the running Docker system?
